column11: Deterministic Inference: Consistent 0.14ms–0.16ms latency validates real-time, bare-metal performance.
Adaptive State Shift: Model triggers 'Rough' classification precisely when accel_z_std spikes from <0.1 to >3.8, proving physics-based perception.
Feature-Driven Discrimination: High gyro_z_std (40+) uniquely isolates 'Gravel' signatures from 'Rough' (lower gyro variance), demonstrating high-resolution perception.
